target: Spoiler-free completion of directed survival goals, outcome branches, rewards, careers, survival ledgers, wildlife, and Wanmami free play

areas.name: Original PC or Mac Route
areas.location_cue: The original launcher, directed-story selector, Wanmami Island selector, profile list, and user-data folder.
areas.note: Chosen route: the standalone Windows or Mac release; the similarly named console game is a different product and is excluded.

save_backup.title: Create a clean profile backup first
save_backup.why: Story rewards, buried-object unlocks, maps, relationships, and the outcome branch are stored in profile data.
save_backup.detail: Copy the complete user-data folder before directed play and keep a separate checkpoint before entering the final temple.

levels.1: Confirm the PC or Mac Stories title rather than the console Castaway game.
levels.2: Install the original release and open its profile selector.
levels.3: Launch the game, create a disposable profile, verify directed Story Mode and Wanmami Island appear, then preserve the untouched user-data folder.

levels.1: Separate profiles allow clean reruns without deleting the completion route.
levels.2: Create and load more than one test profile.
levels.3: Create a second disposable profile, confirm each retains independent story and reward progress, then reserve one slot for the permanent completion run.

levels.1: Scripted portals, lots, rewards, and prompts depend on original neighborhood data.
levels.2: Remove gameplay-changing mods before starting the story.
levels.3: Use a clean user folder, retain only non-gameplay compatibility settings, verify the opening goal appears, and keep the untouched backup separate.
